text:
Aisha (PM): Quick sync: want to launch a 6-week pilot ("Lighthouse") focused on private deployment onboarding + observability + regression detection. Goal: 3 partners, 1 regulated. Need quick checklist and recruitment plan.
Jon (Solutions): +1. propose acceptance gates: onboarding runnable in <=7 days, telemetry shipping, and a partner-provided eval set.
Ravi (Infra): Can reserve a "pilot pool" of 2 gpus per partner for weeks 2-5. need confirmed dates to block capacity.
Tess (Design): We should capture friction points during first-run setup. I'll create a 3-step usability task and a short survey.
Marta (SRE): Observability asks: per-route 95p latency, error rate, token cost per minute, and a trace-id passed from partner. require log forwarder config.
Aisha (PM): Draft acceptance criteria (proposal):
- Legal & security: lightweight NDA signed; if partner sends PII then DPA required
- Onboarding: baseline inference call within 7 business days using our quickstart
- Observability: console shows per-route 95p and avg latency + token cost within 10 days
- Quality: partner-supplied eval harness run weekly; no >7% regression vs their baseline
- Ops: partner agrees to scheduled perf window and can replay 200-500 sample queries
Jon (Solutions): Incentives: 1) full pilot infra credit, 2) up to 8 engineering office-hours (4x 2-hr consults), 3) migration discount if they convert. offer co-marketing for 1 enterprise.
Tess (Design): Feedback cadence: weekly 20m async pulse (form) + biweekly 30m call for the enterprise partner. I'll centralize notes on Notion.
Marta (SRE): Add rollback plan: if error rate >2% for 3 consecutive days or 95p latency > SLO by 2x, auto-fallback to hosted model and a postmortem.
security-bot: Reminder: require security questionnaire submission before granting keys. DPA needed for regulated data.
Aisha (PM): Recruitment: Jon to seed invites from existing Dedicated/Private conversations. open a small public form if slots remain after 5 days.
Ravi (Infra): Quickstart snippet I'll include in runbook:
```
# pilot quickstart
export RW_API_KEY=REDACTED
curl -sS -X POST https://private-redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"open-mosaic-7b","input":"hi"}'
```
Jon (Solutions): I'll draft outreach email + intake form. include a checkbox for "can share eval set" and "needs DPA".
Tess (Design): UX tasks + short form ready in Notion; will post link in 6 hours.
Aisha (PM): Action items: Jon: outreach + intake (48h); Ravi: capacity calendar + quickstart (48h); Marta: observability runbook + perf windows (48h); Tess: UX template (24h); security-bot / Legal: confirm NDA + DPA path (48h); Aisha: publish pilot plan + selection rubric (72h).
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 48h for outstanding deliverables.
Marta (SRE): We'll publish a small load generator and a sample harness (`python harness.py --sample 200`) and a perf window schedule (Tue/Thu 9-11am PT).
Aisha (PM): One more: success metrics for pilot: 1) 80% of partners hit onboarding gate within 7 days, 2) structured feedback score >= 4/5 average, 3) one paid conversion or explicit intent to convert.
Jon (Solutions): Agree. also capture partner asks to feed roadmap prioritization.
Tess (Design): tagging: I'll add a "UX pain" label on the feedback form so we can triage.
Aisha (PM): Great work. I'll post the Notion page and start invites tomorrow morning. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
